Test move declaration refactoring: import additions and deletions.

{
	"experimental":{"interactiveResolve":{"inputTypes":["string"]}}
}

-- settings.json --

	"moveDeclaration": true
}

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module golang.org/lsptests/movedeclimports

go 1.20

-- dest/dest.go --
package dest

func Existing() {}

-- dest/has_import.go --
package dest

import "strings"

func Join(a, b string) string {
	return strings.Join([]string{a, b}, "")
}

-- src/single.go --
package src

import "bytes"

func WriteBuf(b *bytes.Buffer) { //@codeaction(re"WriteBuf", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_single_import)
	b.WriteString("hello")
}

-- src/dup_import.go --
package src

import "strings"

func HasPrefix(s string) bool { //@codeaction(re"HasPrefix", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/has_import.go"}`, result=move_dup_import)
	return strings.HasPrefix(s, "a")
}

-- src/newfile.go --
package src

import "bytes"

func MakeBuf() *bytes.Buffer { //@codeaction(re"MakeBuf", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/newfile.go"}`, result=move_new_file_import)
	return new(bytes.Buffer)
}

-- src/shared.go --

}

	fmt.Println("staying")
}

-- src/multi_spec.go --
package src

import (
	"bytes"
	"strings"
)

func MoveBytes(b *bytes.Buffer) { //@codeaction(re"MoveBytes", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_multi_spec_import)
	b.Reset()
}

func StayStrings(s string) bool {
	return strings.Contains(s, "x")
}

-- src/widget.go --
package src

import "bytes"

// Widget's method is in another file, and both files import "bytes".
type Widget struct { //@codeaction(re"Widget", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_multi_file_import)
	buf *bytes.Buffer
}

-- @move_multi_file_import/dest/dest.go --
package dest

import "bytes"

func Existing() {}

// Widget's method is in another file, and both files import "bytes".
type Widget struct { //@codeaction(re"Widget", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_multi_file_import)
	buf *bytes.Buffer
}

func (w *Widget) Reset() {
	w.buf = new(bytes.Buffer)
}

-- dest/thing.go --
package dest

type Thing int

-- src/uses_dest.go --
package src

import "golang.org/lsptests/movedeclimports/dest"

// UsesDest refers to dest in its signature and body. The dest. qualifiers
// are dropped, and the dest import is removed from src.
func UsesDest(t dest.Thing) dest.Thing { //@codeaction(re"UsesDest", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_uses_dest)
	dest.Existing()
	return t
}

-- @move_uses_dest/dest/dest.go --
package dest

func Existing() {}

// UsesDest refers to dest in its signature and body. The dest. qualifiers
// are dropped, and the dest import is removed from src.
func UsesDest(t Thing) Thing { //@codeaction(re"UsesDest", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_uses_dest)
	Existing()
	return t
}

-- src/uses_dest_shared.go --
package src

import "golang.org/lsptests/movedeclimports/dest"

// MovesWithDest drops its dest. qualifier, but src keeps the dest import
// because StaysWithDest still uses it.
func MovesWithDest() { //@codeaction(re"MovesWithDest", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_uses_dest_shared)
	dest.Existing()
}

func StaysWithDest() {
	dest.Existing()
}

-- @move_uses_dest_shared/dest/dest.go --
package dest

func Existing() {}

// MovesWithDest drops its dest. qualifier, but src keeps the dest import
// because StaysWithDest still uses it.
func MovesWithDest() { //@codeaction(re"MovesWithDest", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_uses_dest_shared)
	Existing()
}
-- @move_uses_dest_shared/src/uses_dest_shared.go --

	dest.Existing()
}

-- src/uses_dest_spec.go --
package src

import "golang.org/lsptests/movedeclimports/dest"

// Only DestThing moves out of the group; its dest. qualifier is dropped.
var (
	DestThing dest.Thing //@codeaction(re"DestThing", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_uses_dest_spec)
	OtherThing dest.Thing
)

	dest.Existing()
}

-- src/order.go --
package src

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"unicode"
)

// Describe needs several imports. Their order in dest must be deterministic.
func Describe(b *bytes.Buffer) error { //@codeaction(re"Describe", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/describe.go"}`, result=move_import_order_new), codeaction(re"Describe", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_import_order_existing)
	if b == nil {
		return errors.New("nil buffer")
	}
	fmt.Fprint(b, strings.ToUpper("x"), unicode.MaxRune)
	return nil
}

-- @move_import_order_existing/dest/dest.go --
package dest

import "bytes"

import "errors"

import "fmt"

import "strings"

import "unicode"

func Existing() {}

// Describe needs several imports. Their order in dest must be deterministic.
func Describe(b *bytes.Buffer) error { //@codeaction(re"Describe", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/describe.go"}`, result=move_import_order_new), codeaction(re"Describe", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_import_order_existing)
	if b == nil {
		return errors.New("nil buffer")
	}
	fmt.Fprint(b, strings.ToUpper("x"), unicode.MaxRune)
	return nil
}

)

	"bytes"

	"strings"
	"unicode"
)

		return errors.New("nil buffer")
